Political Leaders Debate Women's Quota Bill and Delimitation Process

Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and Union Minister Kiren Rijiju engaged in a public exchange regarding the Women's Reservation Bill and the delimitation process. Gandhi questioned why the implementation of the 2023 women's quota law was delayed and linked to delimitation, demanding its immediate, unconditional implementation. Rijiju, in turn, suggested that the women's quota might face delays without early delimitation and challenged the Congress to support the legislation unconditionally. The Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) has called for the immediate passage and implementation of both the women's quota and delimitation bills, a stance that has generated discussion about potential political alliances.
